Consent or pay probe

This page shows a consent wall in the style of Sourcepoint, rendered in a cross-origin iframe. The wall offers a free choice that accepts all cookies and a paid choice that rejects them and removes the adverts for a monthly price.

Wall answers in order: none. Overlay removed: no.

The helper must take the free accept-all choice by itself, and it must never click the paid choice, never start a payment or a login, and never submit anything else. The overlay then goes away.
